components.name: Primary action button
components.description: Brick action used for form submission and high-priority actions.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { appearance: none; align-items: center; background: var(--color-accent); border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-md); color: var(--color-accent-ink); cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; font: 600 .875rem/1.25rem var(--font-sans); justify-content: center; padding: .5rem .75rem; } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Quiet button
components.css: .ds-button-quiet { appearance: none; background: transparent; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-md); color: var(--color-ink-soft); cursor: pointer; font: 400 .875rem/1.25rem var(--font-sans); padding: .5rem .75rem; transition: background var(--duration-quick) var(--ease-smooth), color var(--duration-quick) var(--ease-smooth); } .ds-button-quiet:hover { background: var(--color-line); color: var(--color-ink); } .ds-button-quiet:active { background: var(--color-line-strong); } .ds-button-quiet:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text field
components.description: Compact text field used in workspace and channel forms.
components.css: .ds-field { color: var(--color-ink); display: grid; font: 500 .875rem/1.25rem var(--font-sans); gap: .25rem; } .ds-field input { background: var(--color-paper); border: 1px solid var(--color-line); border-radius: var(--radius-md); color: var(--color-ink); font: 400 .875rem/1.25rem var(--font-sans); padding: .5rem .75rem; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { border-color: var(--color-accent); }

components.name: Conversation navigation
components.description: Active channel row within the plum workspace sidebar.
components.css: .ds-sidebar { background: var(--color-plum-raised); display: grid; gap: .125rem; padding: .5rem; } .ds-nav-item { align-items: center; background: transparent; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-md); color: var(--color-plum-muted); cursor: pointer; display: flex; font: 500 .875rem/1.25rem var(--font-sans); gap: .5rem; height: 2.75rem; padding: 0 .5rem; text-align: left; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: var(--color-plum-hover); color: var(--color-paper); } .ds-nav-item[aria-current="page"] { background: var(--color-paper); color: var(--color-ink); font-weight: 600; } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-paper); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-workspace { align-items: center; background: var(--color-paper); border: 1px solid var(--color-paper); border-radius: var(--radius-lg); color: var(--color-ink); cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; height: 2.75rem; justify-content: center; width: 2.75rem; } .ds-workspace svg { height: 1.5rem; width: 1.5rem; } .ds-workspace:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-paper); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Message composer
components.description: Raised composer surface with integrated text input and primary send action.
components.html: Attach · Emoji
components.css: .ds-composer { background: var(--color-paper-raised); border: 1px solid var(--color-line); border-radius: var(--radius-lg); padding: .25rem; transition: border-color var(--duration-quick) var(--ease-smooth); } .ds-composer:focus-within { border-color: var(--color-accent); } .ds-composer textarea { background: transparent; border: 0; color: var(--color-ink); display: block; font: 400 .875rem/1.5 var(--font-sans); min-height: 2.75rem; padding: .5rem .75rem; resize: vertical; width: 100%; } .ds-composer textarea::placeholder { color: var(--color-ink-faint); } .ds-composer textarea:focus-visible { outline: none; } .ds-composer-tools { align-items: center; color: var(--color-ink-soft); display: flex; font: 400 .75rem/1rem var(--font-sans); gap: .5rem; justify-content: space-between; padding: .25rem; } .ds-send { background: var(--color-accent); border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-md); color: var(--color-accent-ink); cursor: pointer; font: 600 1rem/1 var(--font-sans); height: 2.75rem; width: 2.75rem; } .ds-send:hover { opacity: .9; } .ds-send:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Reaction chip
components.description: Compact reaction with a count and selected state.
components.css: .ds-reaction { align-items: center; background: var(--color-paper-raised); border: 1px solid var(--color-line); border-radius: 999px; color: var(--color-ink); cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; font: 600 .75rem/1rem var(--font-sans); gap: .25rem; padding: .125rem .5rem; } .ds-reaction:hover { background: var(--color-paper); } .ds-reaction[aria-pressed="true"] { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-accent) 10%, var(--color-paper-raised)); border-color: var(--color-accent); } .ds-reaction:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
Orbit pairs a deep plum workspace shell with a warm paper conversation canvas. The split keeps navigation distinct from the work area. Burnt brick marks actions and important message states. The result feels warm, composed, practical, and collaborative. Restrained surfaces keep attention on messages, while active states make the work feel responsive.

The Orbit mark uses two elliptical paths around a central dot. It appears in the workspace rail and on the welcome image. The welcome image shows the mark on a paper desk scene. Keep that imagery in its existing welcome context. No visual anti-reference was specified.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper surfaces against a dark plum navigation shell.
Burnt-brick actions and compact message-state cues.
A dense, responsive conversation layout with a dockable thread pane.
Soft shadows reserved for floating or temporary surfaces.

rules.name: The Signal, Not Surface Rule
rules.body: Use Burnt Brick for actions and small state cues. Keep large working surfaces neutral.

rules.name: The Compact Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Keep most conversation content at 0.875rem. Use larger sizes for pane and dialog titles, not for routine message text.

rules.name: The Single Pane Rule
rules.body: On narrow screens, keep navigation, conversation, and thread views as separate panes. Do not compress the desktop columns into a narrow three-column layout.

rules.name: The Docked-Flat Rule
rules.body: Use the pop shadow for floating surfaces. Keep docked panels flat and separated by borders.

dos: **Do** use Burnt Brick for primary actions and small state indicators.
**Do** preserve the plum navigation shell and warm paper conversation surfaces.
**Do** keep the message composer visually attached to the conversation pane.
**Do** show keyboard focus with a visible 2px outline.
**Do** honor reduced-motion preferences for animated surfaces.
donts: **Don't** use the pop shadow on docked or resting content panels.
**Don't** turn the accent color into a large background surface.
**Don't** compress the narrow-screen interface into three persistent columns.
**Don't** use the seeded avatar colors as general status or action colors.
